zh.title: 美研究團隊於實驗室測試波音737航電 示範實體訊號干擾
zh.summary: 加州大學聖地牙哥分校於實驗室測試波音737航電；示範干擾飛行管理資料
body: 美國加州大學聖地牙哥分校與歐柏林學院的研究團隊，在受控的實驗室環境中，使用真實的波音737航電設備，展示了一項針對飛機通訊系統的網路安全測試技術。
研究人員將一枚硬幣大小的電子裝置，連接至駕駛艙下方電子設備艙內的維護介面。該裝置透過在ARINC 429資料匯流排上注入電氣訊號，掩蓋原本的正常訊號並替換為經篡改的資料。
在實驗室測試中，研究人員成功干擾並修改了飛行管理電腦的資料，包含飛行計畫與航務計算所需的飛機重量等參數。研究團隊強調，此項實驗完全於實驗室內進行，且必須在地面取得飛機的實體接觸權限才能安裝硬體。

en.title: Researchers Demonstrate Physical Cybersecurity Attack on Boeing 737 Avionics in Lab
en.summary: US researchers demonstrated lab-based signal injection on Boeing 737 avionics to alter flight management data.
body: A research team from the University of California San Diego and Oberlin College demonstrated a cybersecurity testing technique using genuine Boeing 737 avionics under controlled laboratory conditions.

Researchers attached a coin-sized electronic implant to a maintenance connection inside the Electronics and Equipment bay beneath the flight deck. By injecting electrical signals onto the ARINC 429 data bus, the device overpowered legitimate communication streams and substituted manipulated data.

In laboratory demonstrations, the team altered Flight Management Computer data, including flight plans and aircraft weight calculations. Researchers emphasized that the experiment required physical ground access to the aircraft and was not conducted on operational flights.

zh.title: QantasLink退役福克100客機捐贈HARS博物館展示
zh.summary: QantasLink捐贈退役福克100客機予HARS；8月17日飛抵沃隆岡機場展出
body: 澳洲航空旗下區域航空公司 QantasLink 退役的一架福克100（Fokker 100）客機於 8 月 17 日完成最後一次飛行，從卡爾古利（KGI）飛抵沃隆岡-雪爾哈巴機場（WOL），正式進駐歷史飛機還原協會（HARS）博物館。這架登記號為 VH-NPU、名為「Meekatharra」的 100 座級客機，由 QantasLink 捐贈予 HARS 作為公開展品展示。
這是 QantasLink 捐贈給 HARS 的第二架福克100客機，先前另一架登記號 VH-NHO 的同型機已於今年 2 月移交至該協位於西澳洲的帕克斯博物館。HARS 位於新南威爾斯州雪爾哈巴，館內已收藏多架澳洲航空退役的經典機型，包含波音747-400與波音707等民航機與軍用機展品。
登記號 VH-NPU 的客機於 1994 年 3 月首飛，在加入 QantasLink 機隊前曾先後服役於美國航空與奧地利航空。該機於 2016 年 12 月正式加入 QantasLink，為該公司引進的最後一架福克100客機。在為 QantasLink 服務期間，該機累計飛行超過 11,250 小時，載運約 100 萬名旅客，主要支援西澳洲區域航線及礦業接駁任務。
QantasLink 執行長 Mark Dal Pra 表示，「Meekatharra」在過去近十年間於連接西澳洲區域社區方面發揮了重要作用，公司很高興這架客機將由 HARS 保存給世代航空愛好者。HARS 主席兼總飛行員 Bob De La Hunty 亦指出，志工團隊將致力於維護這些歷史故事，讓到訪民眾能近距離體驗這些傑出的飛機。
QantasLink 目前正逐步以聯盟航空（Alliance Airlines）營運的巴西航空工業E190（ICAO機型代碼E190）區域客機取代高齡的福克100機隊。根據規劃，首架替代用的巴西航空工業E190客機預計將於 9 月抵達伯斯，引進後將為西澳洲營運網路提供更高的可靠度、燃油效率及乘客舒適度。

en.title: QantasLink Donates Retired Fokker 100 Aircraft to HARS Museum
en.summary: QantasLink donates a retired Fokker 100 aircraft to the HARS Museum at Wollongong Airport.
body: A retired QantasLink Fokker 100 aircraft completed its final flight on August 17, flying from Kalgoorlie (KGI) to Wollongong-Shellharbour Airport (WOL) to take up residence at the Historical Aircraft Restoration Society (HARS) museum. The 100-seat regional jet, registered VH-NPU and named "Meekatharra", was donated by QantasLink to join the museum's collection as a permanent public exhibit.

The aircraft represents the second former QantasLink Fokker 100 donated to HARS, following another unit registered VH-NHO that was sent to the society's Parkes Museum in Western Australia in February. Based in Shellharbour, New South Wales, HARS maintains a collection of historic civil and military aircraft, including a previously donated Qantas Boeing 747-400 (VH-OJA) and a classic Boeing 707.

VH-NPU performed its first flight in March 1994 and previously operated for American Airlines and Austrian Airlines before joining QantasLink in December 2016 as the final Fokker 100 added to its fleet. During its service with QantasLink, the regional jet logged over 11,250 flight hours and carried roughly one million passengers across regional Western Australia, including fly-in-fly-out operations for the local resource sector.

QantasLink Chief Executive Officer Mark Dal Pra noted that the aircraft played a critical role connecting regional communities across Western Australia for nearly a decade and expressed satisfaction that HARS would preserve it for future generations. HARS President and Chief Pilot Bob De La Hunty added that museum volunteers are dedicated to keeping aviation stories alive and allowing visitors to experience the aircraft up close.

QantasLink is progressively replacing its aging fleet of Fokker 100s with Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) regional aircraft operated by Alliance Airlines. The airline expects the first replacement E190 jet to arrive in Perth in September, bringing improved fuel efficiency, operational reliability, and enhanced customer comfort to routes across Western Australia.

zh.title: 美國空軍2027財年擬退役149架軍機並增購F-15EX
zh.summary: 美空軍擬於2027財年退役149架軍機並將F-15EX採購目標增至267架
body: 根據2026年8月18日發布的提案，美國空軍正尋求國會批准，於2027財年退役總計149架軍機。此舉旨在釋出資金，以用於採購下一代戰鬥機與協同作戰飛機（CCA）。目前，排除教練機與無人機後，美國空軍的現役軍機總數約為4,000架。
2027財年的擬退役計劃包含：49架A-10「疣豬」攻擊機、23架U-2「蛟龍夫人」偵察機、20架KC-135空中加油機、20架F-15E戰擊機、16架舊型C-130H運輸機，以及6架F-16「戰隼」戰鬥機。相較於2026財年最初計劃退役的336架軍機（其中包含整支共162架的A-10機隊、62架F-16C/D、35架T-1A及21架F-15E），本次申請的退役數量已有顯著下降。

在F-15E的處置方面，2026年國防授權法（NDAA）規定2027財年退役上限為21架、2028財年為30架（兩年總計51架），因此美軍此次申請退役20架F-15E符合該法規限制。此外，美軍在「史詩憤怒行動」（Operation Epic Fury）中損失了至少4架F-15E。與此同時，美國空軍正將下一代F-15EX「鷹式二型」（Eagle II）的採購目標提升至267架，並加大投資以加速生產。
針對洛克希德（Lockheed）U-2偵察機機隊，儘管美軍多年來一直計劃將其退役，且先前預估將於2027年退役，但國會可能不會完全批准這23架的退役申請，反而可能要求空軍恢復更多「蛟龍夫人」偵察機。另外，KC-135加油機的退役計劃也受到法律限制，國會要求美軍在2028年10月前必須維持502架加油機服役（高於先前要求的466架）。
在其他機種方面，國會先前多次阻擋美軍退役32架用於訓練的Block 20批次F-22「猛禽」戰鬥機，美軍已在2026及2027財年放棄提出該機型的退役申請。雖然國會已允許空軍逐步淘汰其餘的F-15C/D，但2027財年的申請案仍保留了現存全部42架的F-15C/D。

en.title: US Air Force Proposes Retiring 149 Aircraft in Fiscal 2027 and Ramping Up F-15EX Procurement
en.summary: The US Air Force proposes retiring 149 aircraft in Fiscal 2027 to fund newer fighter jets.
body: The United States Air Force is seeking congressional approval to retire a total of 149 aircraft in Fiscal Year 2027. The proposal is part of an ongoing effort to free up funds for the procurement of next-generation fighter jets and Collaborative Combat Aircraft. The current United States aircraft inventory, excluding trainers and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), stands at approximately 4,000 aircraft.

The proposed divestments for Fiscal 2027 include 49 A-10 Warthogs, 23 U-2 Dragon Ladies, 20 KC-135 tankers, 20 F-15Es, 16 legacy C-130H Hercules aircraft, and six F-16 Fighting Falcons. This request represents a significant decrease compared to the Air Force's initial Fiscal 2026 budget proposal, which sought the retirement of 336 aircraft, including the entire fleet of 162 A-10 Warthogs, 62 F-16C/D Fighting Falcons, 35 T-1A Jayhawks, and 21 F-15Es.

According to the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) of 2026, a ceiling has been established allowing up to 21 F-15E retirements in Fiscal 2027 and 30 in Fiscal 2028, totaling 51 over two years. The current request of 20 F-15E retirements aligns with this ceiling. Meanwhile, the Air Force is raising its procurement target for the next-generation F-15EX Eagle II to 267 aircraft while investing more to accelerate production. Additionally, the service lost at least four F-15Es during Operation Epic Fury.

The service's effort to retire its Lockheed U-2 fleet has faced ongoing negotiations, with previous budget plans aiming for retirement in 2027. However, Congress may require the Air Force to restore more U-2 aircraft instead of fully approving the 23 divestments. Furthermore, the retirement of KC-135 tankers is restricted by a legislative requirement to maintain 502 tankers in service by October 2028, up from the previous requirement of 466 aircraft.

For older combat aircraft, Congress has historically blocked attempts to retire the 32 training-coded Block 20 F-22 Raptors. Consequently, the Air Force has omitted them from its retirement requests for both Fiscal 2026 and Fiscal 2027. The Fiscal 2027 budget request also retains all 42 remaining F-15C/D aircraft, even though Congress has previously allowed the phasing out of older F-15C/D models.

zh.title: Airchair推出評估工具 協助航空公司因應美國運輸部機上輪椅新規
zh.summary: Airchair推出線上評估工具；協助航空業者因應美國運輸部機上輪椅新規
body: 機具製造商 Airchair 宣布推出免費線上評估工具，協助航空公司確認其營運是否適用美國運輸部（DOT）即將實施的機上輪椅無障礙新規定。該工具可在數分鐘內，針對航空公司的機型與機隊佈局提供法規檢視與後續建議。
根據美國聯邦法規 14 CFR 382.65，自 2026 年 10 月 2 日起，座位數達 125 席以上且設有洗手洗手間的新交付單通道客機，必須配備符合提升標準的機上輪椅。此外，自 2031 年 10 月 2 日起，所有超過 60 席客機配備的機上輪椅均須符合該規範。

en.title: Airchair Launches Assessment Tool for Upcoming US DOT Onboard Wheelchair Rules
en.summary: Airchair launched a compliance tool helping airlines meet US DOT onboard wheelchair accessibility rules by October 2026.
body: Airchair has introduced a free online assessment tool to help airlines evaluate whether upcoming US Department of Transportation (DOT) onboard wheelchair requirements apply to their fleet operations. The compliance tool guides air carriers through questions regarding aircraft types, route networks, and existing equipment to determine necessary operational steps ahead of new accessibility mandates.

Under federal regulations 14 CFR 382.65, newly delivered single-aisle aircraft with an FAA-certified maximum seating capacity of at least 125 seats equipped with lavatories must feature enhanced onboard wheelchairs starting October 2, 2026. Furthermore, by October 2, 2031, all passenger aircraft with more than 60 seats must maintain onboard wheelchairs that comply with the updated DOT accessibility standards.
